requirements_summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS: customer-facing assistant + in-app doc search + personalized recommendations. Latency SLOs: chat 80-150ms p50, p95 <350ms; embeddings throughput 200-500 reqs/min; cost-sensitive—looking to trade model size vs unit cost. Require VPC for Dedicated, SSO/SAML, KMS-managed keys, audit logs retained 1 year, and option for EU data residency. Want clear rollback & failover policies for model regressions.
notes:
- Current evaluation flow: started with Hosted API for quick proof-of-concept -> moving to Dedicated for production isolation and predictable throughput.
- POC ask: 4-week Dedicated POC (staging traffic) to validate autoscaling, canary routing, and failover plan.
- Canary plan discussed on call (10/24): run 2 canary pools (us-east-1, us-west-2) at 5-10% traffic;metric checks: error rate, latency, model quality (human eval on 200 prompts).
- Fallback routing: primary -> Dedicated variant A (quantized 8-bit medium); on capacity or degraded metrics automatically route to Variant B (higher-latency hosted_api model) in eu-west as secondary. Manual rollback triggers: >2% HTTP 5xx, p95 latency >500ms for 5m window, or quality regression (BLEU/ROUGE drop >4 pts) per eval set.
- Quote from CPO: "We need a safe rollout path — preferring canary + auto-fallback to keep customer-facing flows online."
- Technical asks: KV/prefix caching to reduce token spend, suggestions on quantization profiles for MPT/GPT-family open models, token-level cost breakdown in Console.
- Security: legal wants explicit language on non-training of models with PII; infra wants VPC peering and HSM/KMS integration details.
- Procurement: needs finalized pricing & SOW with reserved throughput tiers.
- Internal champion: Head of ML Eng (Nora H.) - pushing for Dedicated to hit latency targets; Eng manager (Luis P.) owns infra sign-off.
- Risk: If Dedicated POC extends past 6 weeks procurement may re-open RFP vs other vendors.
- Good signal: demo of streaming + cost estimate landed well; team used Redwood SDK during trial and saw predictable p50 latencies.
